wikitext: {{Velious Era}} [[File:Npc_captain_bvellos.png|right|200px]] [[File:Npc_watchman_gardal.jpg|right|200px]] {{Factionpage| | description = The Storm Giants are the upper class of Kael Drakkel. They are naturally allied with the [[Kromrif]] and their king, [[Tormax]]. They are opposed to the [[Claws of Veeshan]], but usually will not give positive faction with [[Coldain]] when killed. Most Kromzek giants appear with plate armor resembling Lorica segmentata [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lorica_segmentata] or noble robes and reside within [[Kael Drakkel]] and [[The Wakening Land]]. Most characters will start as kill on sight to this faction, except [[Rallos Zek]] [[Ogre]]s. Note: the wiki faction values for Thurgadin mobs are wrong.
